source.name: NASA/JPL Horizons, DE441
source.coordinates: Apparent airless azimuth/elevation, azimuth clockwise from north; angular diameters converted from arcseconds to degrees; UTC timestamps.

limitations: Ephemeris directions are computed source values; terrain visibility and sampled intervals remain estimates.
One-hour samples do not resolve sub-hour visibility transitions.
Observer directions use2m above the sampled terrain; changing mast height changes horizon obstruction only (tiny18m observer parallax ignored).
No atmospheric refraction; no diffraction, link budget, relay spacecraft, solar panels, or terrain uncertainty model.
